text: Cycling remains a widely practiced, low-impact activity known to strengthen cardiovascular function, build muscle, and expand stamina. Choosing a bike requires selecting tires that balance grip, longevity, and rider comfort effectively. Most cycling-specific tires feature treads engineered for traction across gravel, dirt paths, and asphalt surfaces. Properly fitted tires improve ride quality by smoothing the journey. Safety also demands dependable brakes that offer consistent stopping power in rain or on slick roads; these components must be simple to adjust and built for reliability.
